summary: [standards] The round-2 evidence is not of the reviewed code. The 41 evidence records written at b035f391 carry code_tree 84454e66; the code tree of 73e2b1a0 (and of b035f391, which adds only ledger records) is e8555372, computed by canon itself (`finding add --rev 73e2b1a0` records it) and by replaying the code-tree rule (everything but .canon/, specs roots, docs/** and *.md) on every main commit from 024e28b1 to b035f391 and on 73e2b1a0 cherry-picked onto 024e28b1 (04a08aa4): none gives 84454e66. So the junit run (3732/3733) was taken from a worktree whose code was neither the merged tip nor the pre-rebase one, with worktree_dirty false. I did not rely on it: I ran the tests bound to what I signed at 73e2b1a0 (atip_incomplete 14, artifacts_object_store 27, strategy_promote 36, plugin_sync 16, migrate 11, init 11, all passed) plus real-binary probes. Ask: re-attest from a clean checkout of the commit that is merged, so a later review can take the junit as given.
